payload.title: Run a multi-file C++ project
payload.description:
As the student, I want to compile and run a multi-file C++ project, so that I can practice real programs.

Feature: Run a multi-file C++ project
  Scenario: Compile and run two source files
    Given a C++ project with main.cpp and util.cpp where main prints util's greeting
    When the project is run
    Then the exit status is 0
    And the output is the greeting

  Scenario: A compile error is reported
    Given a C++ project with a syntax error in main.cpp
    When the project is run
    Then the compiler error mentions main.cpp and its line number
    And the program is not executed
